paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 38b, reporting Abaye; Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim cites a reading that it should be Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Berakhot 38b paragraph names Ravnai reporting Abaye. The should-read Rava variant remains Hyman’s Dikdukei Soferim report, not a fresh apparatus collation, a silent replacement, or an identity merge.
